title: Minimum time calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute t_min = d/v₂ = 60/3 = 20 s.

title: Shortest distance calculation
description: Essential Criteria: Student must correctly compute the shortest crossing distance as 120 m.

title: Velocity component analysis
description: Important Criteria: Student must recognize that for minimum crossing time, the boat's heading should be perpendicular to the riverbank.

title: Resultant velocity geometry
description: Important Criteria: Student must apply vector addition to find the boat's resultant velocity relative to ground.

title: Optimal heading determination
description: Important Criteria: Student must determine the optimal heading angle for shortest crossing distance using trigonometry.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional Criteria: Student should maintain consistent units throughout calculations.

title: Confusing time and distance
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student incorrectly assumes the same heading minimizes both time and distance.

title: Incorrect velocity ratio
description: Pitfall Criteria: Student mistakenly uses v₁/v₂ instead of v₂/v₁ when calculating the optimal angle.
